narr: Widespread pulse thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain across the Midlands, including isolated flash flooding in the Columbia metro in the evening of September 20th. Above average precipitable water, a weak approaching trough, and little wind shear produced slow moving storms with highly efficient rain rates of 3-4 inches per hour.
